name: Geologic Map of Mars (USGS SIM 3292)
mission: USGS Astrogeology (Tanaka, Skinner, Dohm, Irwin, Kolb, Fortezzo, Platz, Michael and Hare, 2014)
product: SIM3292_Global_Geology feature layer on NASA Mars Trek
notes: Queried from https://trek.nasa.gov/mars/trekarcgis/rest/services/SIM3292_Global_Geology/MapServer/0/query for the region envelope, clipped to it, borders simplified to about 1 km. Colours are the USGS map colours from the layer's renderer. The map was made at 1:20,000,000, so unit borders are good to a few kilometres at best. The one-line descriptions, periods and ages in words are plain-English summaries of the map's unit descriptions; ages follow the period boundaries of Michael (2013): Noachian before about 3.7 billion years ago, Hesperian to about 3.4, Amazonian since.
